warn_no_api_key_body: No unique API key (api_key) is configured for your user. Quick-block links in notification emails will not work.
index_empty: No records found matching the selected criteria.
new_bundle_hint_prefix: To match a substring, wrap the message text in double curly braces, for example:
detail_msg_blocked_body: The bundle has been blocked. Notifications for it will no longer be sent.
detail_trigger_count: Trigger count within retention period ({days} days):
detail_edit_hint_prefix: Tip: to check only for the presence of a text fragment in the log, wrap it in double curly braces:
settings_saved_body: Settings have been successfully written to the configuration file.
settings_language_desc: Display language for the web interface and outgoing email notifications.
settings_listen_host_desc: Network address on which the web interface accepts connections (0.0.0.0 means all interfaces). Applies after service restart.
settings_listen_port_desc: TCP port for accessing the web interface and receiving events from Vector. Applies after service restart.
settings_base_url_desc: Base application URL used to build quick-block links in emails (e.g., http://nas.lan:8080). When enabling HTTPS, remember to change the prefix to https://.
settings_log_level_desc: Verbosity of the application system log upon service startup.
settings_https_enabled_desc: Run the built-in web server over HTTPS. Certificate and private key files must reside in the data/ directory. Applies after service restart.
settings_ssl_certfile_desc: Certificate file name only inside the data/ directory (e.g., cert.pem), without any directory path.
settings_ssl_keyfile_desc: Private key file name only inside the data/ directory (e.g., key.pem), without any directory path.
settings_db_backend_desc: SQLite mode: in-memory reduces NAS disk wake-ups, on-disk persists every event immediately. Applies after service restart.
settings_memory_flush_desc: How often to persist the in-memory database to disk in sqlite_memory mode (if changes occurred).
settings_retention_days_desc: Number of days to keep trigger history records and inactive bundles before automatic cleanup.
settings_page_size_desc: Maximum number of bundles displayed per page on the main page.
settings_batch_delay_desc: Wait time before sending an email to combine multiple failures from the same host into one digest (0 sends immediately).
settings_smtp_host_desc: Mail server hostname or IP address for sending notification emails.
settings_smtp_port_desc: Mail server port (typically 465 for SSL or 587 for STARTTLS).
settings_smtp_use_ssl_desc: Encrypted connection to the mail server immediately upon connect (port 465).
settings_smtp_use_starttls_desc: Upgrade to an encrypted connection after initial plain connection (typically port 587).
settings_smtp_verify_ssl_desc: Verify the authenticity of the mail server certificate (disable for self-signed certificates on a local NAS).
settings_smtp_user_desc: Account username for mail server authentication (leave empty if authentication is not required).
settings_smtp_password_desc: Leave blank to keep the current mailbox password unchanged.
settings_smtp_from_desc: Email address shown in the 'From' field of outgoing notifications.
settings_smtp_to_desc: One or more notification recipient email addresses separated by commas.
err_disallowed_fields: Request rejected: disallowed or invalid configuration parameters submitted.
err_empty_listen_host: Server IP address cannot be empty.
err_invalid_listen_port: Server port must be between 1 and 65535.
err_invalid_memory_flush: Disk flush interval must be at least 10 seconds.
err_invalid_retention: History retention period must be at least 1 day.
err_invalid_batch_delay: Email grouping delay cannot be negative.
err_invalid_page_size: Bundles per page must be at least 1.
err_empty_smtp_host: SMTP server address cannot be empty.
err_invalid_smtp_port: SMTP server port must be between 1 and 65535.
err_empty_smtp_from: SMTP sender address cannot be empty.
err_empty_smtp_to: Specify at least one notification recipient address.
err_https_missing_files: When HTTPS is enabled, both SSL certificate and private key file names must be specified.
err_https_invalid_filename: Specify only the file name without directories or path separators: {filename}
err_https_cert_not_found: SSL certificate file not found in the data/ directory: {filename}
err_https_key_not_found: SSL private key file not found in the data/ directory: {filename}
